title: Driving Feel and Enjoyment
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly praise the G60's driving feel and fun-to-drive character, while a few mention the experience being less enjoyable or uncomfortable and many other fragments only reference driving without clear evaluation.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle's driving feel as the aspect owners love most and describe it as enjoyable to drive.

negative.summary: Negative reviews say the vehicle is less enjoyable to drive than expected or uncomfortable in one-handed driving.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention driving history or very early ownership without stating whether the driving experience is good or bad.

limitations: The sampled evidence is heavily repetitive, with many positive fragments using the same wording, so concrete variation in what makes the driving experience fun is not observable here.
Negative evidence is sparse, so the specific drawbacks are only lightly evidenced.
Many undetermined fragments refer to driving context without evaluative detail, which limits interpretation of unclear mentions.
